FX-LBLUR-001.says: The bar, length 3: a clean straight line has nothing to smooth, and every pixel stays as it was, to within rounding.

FX-LBLUR-002.says: The stepped diagonal, length 4: the steps soften into a slope. The empty pixel in the crook of each step takes some ink, the step pixels give some up, and nothing more than one pixel from the line changes much.

FX-LBLUR-003.says: The face, length 3: the box's straight sides, the flat skin and the red line's middle stay as they are; the red line's ends taper into the skin, and the box's inside corners round off, the skin in each taking some of the line.

FX-LBLUR-004.says: FX-LBLUR-003 at strength 50: every pixel halfway between the drawing and FX-LBLUR-003.

FX-LBLUR-005.says: FX-LBLUR-003 with lines only: each pixel changes by FX-LBLUR-003's change times its own ink, so the empty outside stays empty and the skin moves less than the lines.

FX-LBLUR-007.says: The stepped diagonal with the length keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 4 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is the drawing, frame 2 softens it less, and frame 4 is FX-LBLUR-002.

FX-LBLUR-008.says: FX-LBLUR-002 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-LBLUR-010.says: The bar, length 50, the most: each side of the blur stops where the line ends, so the bar is still as it was, to within rounding.

FX-LBLUR-011.says: Length 51, above 50. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-LBLUR-012.says: Length -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-LBLUR-013.says: Length keyed to 60 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-LBLUR-014.says: Strength 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-LBLUR-015.says: Strength -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-LBLUR-016.says: Lines only written "yes", not true or false. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
